**Notion Kicks Off Employee Share Sale At $11 Billion Valuation As AI Accelerates Its Growth**

Notion, known for its popular productivity software application, has recently allowed its employees to sell some of their shares at an $11 billion valuation. This development comes amidst the company's accelerating growth due to its AI offerings, with $600 million in annual recurring revenue, half of which is attributed to its AI products. Furthermore, Notion is reportedly cash flow positive. Bloomberg had previously reported that the company was considering a tender offer at a $12 billion valuation.

**Source:** [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/annatong/2025/12/15/notion-kicks-off-employee-share-sale-at-11-billion-valuation-as-ai-accelerates-its-growth)

This trigger highlights Notion's significant growth and valuation increase, fueled by its advancements in AI technology.
Vercel: Vercel, an American cloud application company, is known for creating and maintaining the Next.js web development framework. Recently, Vercel has made significant strides in the AI space by releasing a new AI agent framework called "Eve." As of July 2026, Vercel has open-sourced Eve, which simplifies building production-ready AI agents into a single folder structure primarily consisting of markdown files. This new framework allows the entire process, from scaffolding to deployment, to be performed with straightforward commands and natural language prompts. Vercel's innovative approach with Eve is revolutionizing how production AI agents are developed and deployed, showcasing their leading edge in the technological landscape.
Stripe:
Online payments giant Stripe has released its annual letter for 2023, unveiling some interesting stats about the company and its direction, as well as the overall health of the internet economy. The Stripe annual letter, signed by co-founders and brothers Patrick and John Collison, indicated that Stripe’s payment volumes in 2023 rose by 25% from the prior year to more than $1 trillion, or about 1% of total global GDP. The core idea behind the company—one that they endeavor to take very seriously—is that they are still early in the journey of software-driven innovation. Stripe is an applied exercise in thinking through some of the corollaries of that. In particular, thanks to the new possibilities afforded by the internet, they believe that putting better—more global, easier to use, more flexible, faster, cheaper—economic infrastructure in the hands of companies and entrepreneurs will lead to a more vibrant and prosperous world. 

Source: [Stripe passes $1 trillion in payment volume in 2023 - FX News Group](https://fxnewsgroup.com/forex-news/payments/stripe-passes-1-trillion-in-payment-volume-in-2023)
